name: 49441 · Norton Shores, MI
findings: ZIP 49441 (Norton Shores) has 155 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 62 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49441 (Norton Shores) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49441 (Norton Shores) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 54 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
